verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה בְּנֵ֣י אֵלִ֑ים הָב֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ hā·ḇū Yah·weh bə·nê ’ê·lîm hā·ḇū Yah·weh kā·ḇō·wḏ wā·‘ōz
verses.literal: A Psalm of David Ascribe to the LORD O heavenly beings . . . ascribe to the LORD glory and strength

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לַֽ֭יהוָה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בְּהַדְרַת־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū Yah·weh kə·ḇō·wḏ šə·mōw hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh bə·haḏ·raṯ- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness

verses.original: ק֥וֹל יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ הַ֫מָּ֥יִם אֵֽל־ הַכָּב֥וֹד הִרְעִ֑ים יְ֝הוָ֗ה עַל־ מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl Yah·weh ‘al- ham·mā·yim ’êl- hak·kā·ḇō·wḏ hir·‘îm Yah·weh ‘al- ma·yim rab·bîm
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD is over the waters the God of glory thunders the LORD is heard over many waters

verses.original: קוֹל־ יְהוָ֥ה בַּכֹּ֑חַ ק֥וֹל יְ֝הוָ֗ה בֶּהָדָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl- Yah·weh bak·kō·aḥ qō·wl Yah·weh be·hā·ḏār
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD is powerful the voice of the LORD is majestic

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה שֹׁבֵ֣ר אֲרָזִ֑ים וַיְשַׁבֵּ֥ר יְ֝הוָ֗ה אֶת־ אַרְזֵ֥י הַלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl Yah·weh šō·ḇêr ’ă·rā·zîm way·šab·bêr Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ar·zê hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon

verses.original: וַיַּרְקִידֵ֥ם כְּמוֹ־ עֵ֑גֶל לְבָנ֥וֹן וְ֝שִׂרְיֹ֗ן כְּמ֣וֹ בֶן־ רְאֵמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar·qî·ḏêm kə·mōw- ‘ê·ḡel lə·ḇā·nō·wn wə·śir·yōn kə·mōw ḇen- rə·’ê·mîm
verses.literal: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf and Sirion like a young wild ox
The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire

verses.original: ק֣וֹל יְ֭הוָה יָחִ֣יל מִדְבָּ֑ר יָחִ֥יל יְ֝הוָ֗ה מִדְבַּ֥ר קָדֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl Yah·weh yā·ḥîl miḏ·bār yā·ḥîl Yah·weh miḏ·bar qā·ḏêš
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהוָ֨ה׀ יְחוֹלֵ֣ל אַיָּלוֹת֮ וַֽיֶּחֱשֹׂ֪ף יְעָ֫ר֥וֹת וּבְהֵיכָל֑וֹ כֻּ֝לּ֗וֹ אֹמֵ֥ר כָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: qō·wl Yah·weh yə·ḥō·w·lêl ’ay·yā·lō·wṯ way·ye·ḥĕ·śōp̄ yə·‘ā·rō·wṯ ū·ḇə·hê·ḵā·lōw kul·lōw ’ō·mêr kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare And in His temple all cry Glory

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה לַמַּבּ֣וּל יָשָׁ֑ב וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יְ֝הוָ֗ה מֶ֣לֶךְ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh lam·mab·būl yā·šāḇ way·yê·šeḇ Yah·weh me·leḵ lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood the LORD is enthroned as King forever

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה עֹ֭ז לְעַמּ֣וֹ יִתֵּ֑ן יְהוָ֓ה׀ יְבָרֵ֖ךְ אֶת־ עַמּ֣וֹ בַשָּׁלֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ōz lə·‘am·mōw yit·tên Yah·weh yə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- ‘am·mōw ḇaš·šā·lō·wm
verses.literal: The LORD gives His people strength the LORD blesses His people with peace
